correctness.rationale: The stated graph allows neighboring occupied rows only when both contain the same single color. Independently enumerating compatible cyclic row subsets gives all 36,069 faces and the stated cardinality distribution. The bundled Morse proof uses the full acyclicity check and a signed unit-pivot boundary projection; the 12-by-9 array represents the transpose of the column-convention differential, leaving Smith factors unchanged. Independently, branches/audit5.py and audit5.out use actual unit Gaussian cancellations over Z, top degree down on the uncompressed augmented boundary, without a prespecified matching. Unit clearing changes only the cancelled basis vector in the next lower boundary; precisely three degree-three and six degree-four basis classes survive and no nonzero boundary remains. For a nonidentity rotation, the only fixed nonempty simplices are the four single-color 6-simplices, each with a positive orientation sign. The augmented trace is 3, independently confirmed for all six powers. The degree-three representation is trivial since a nontrivial rational C7 constituent has dimension six. The degree-four trace is then 6, ruling out that constituent there too. Integral freeness makes rational triviality faithful; barycentric subdivision and rational coinvariant exactness give the geometric quotient ranks without assuming freeness or making an integral quotient claim.
